GetVersion.description: Gets data about the current plugin and RPC version.

GetStats.description: Gets statistics about OBS, obs-websocket, and the current session.

BroadcastCustomEvent.description: Broadcasts a `CustomEvent` to all WebSocket clients. Receivers are clients which are identified and subscribed.

fields.name: eventData
fields.description: Data payload to emit to all receivers

CallVendorRequest.description: Call a request registered to a vendor.

fields.name: vendorName
fields.description: Name of the vendor to use

GetHotkeyList.description: Gets an array of all hotkey names in OBS.

TriggerHotkeyByName.description: Triggers a hotkey using its name. See `GetHotkeyList`.

fields.name: hotkeyName
fields.description: Name of the hotkey to trigger

fields.name: contextName
fields.description: Name of context of the hotkey to trigger

TriggerHotkeyByKeySequence.description: Triggers a hotkey using a sequence of keys.

fields.name: keyId
fields.description: The OBS key ID to use. See https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/blob/master/libobs/obs-hotkeys.h

fields.name: keyModifiers
fields.description: Object containing key modifiers to apply

Sleep.description: Sleeps for a time duration or number of frames. Only available in request batches with types `SERIAL_REALTIME` or `SERIAL_FRAME`.

fields.name: sleepMillis
fields.description: Number of milliseconds to sleep for (if `SERIAL_REALTIME` mode)

fields.name: sleepFrames
fields.description: Number of frames to sleep for (if `SERIAL_FRAME` mode)
